svg.title: Dark Green Curve, 1982 — interpretive SVG study
svg.desc: Single dark-green shaped canvas: curved upper edge, pointed left end and straight sloping lower edge. Photo perspective is approximated; background omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of green; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary record: https://hirshhorn.si.edu/collection/artwork/?edanUrl=edanmdm%3Ahmsg_07.31; visual reference: https://ids.si.edu/ids/deliveryService?id=HMSG-HMSG-07.31; reviewed 2026-10-27; hand-authored interpretive study, not a facsimile; approximate geometry and interpretive screen colours.
